metadata.domain: Cathode Materials / Advanced Materials / Battery Materials

evidence.trl_pathway: T01 (TRL6→completion in 2yr) and T02 (TRL5→completion in 2yr) are reasonable for process/material maturation; T03 (TRL4→completion in 4yr) is appropriately paced for an early-stage material, making all pathways broadly realistic.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The portfolio includes mid-to-lower TRL technologies (TRL 4-6) consistent with 기술선도, but all three selections are relatively near-market materials rather than truly exploratory frontier research, and the short 3-technology portfolio lacks the R&D-heavy depth expected of a technology leadership strategy.
evidence.competitive_awareness: All three technologies are firmly within the Cathode/Battery Materials domain, demonstrating solid domain alignment; the selection covers nickel-rich, solid-state, and sodium-ion vectors which represent the major competitive battlegrounds in next-generation battery materials.
evidence.market_timing: Under 기술선도, completing 1-2 years before boom is ideal; T01 completes 0.75yr after boom (slight miss), T02 completes 1.5yr after boom (significant miss for preemption), and T03 completes 1.0yr after boom — none achieve the pre-boom positioning that technology leadership demands.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies (high-Ni precursor, solid-state cathode, Na-ion anode) are all active patent filing areas with growing markets, suggesting reasonable convergence awareness, but the roadmap documentation does not provide explicit evidence of deliberate convergence-zone targeting methodology.

strengths: All three technologies are strictly on-domain within battery/cathode materials, ensuring competitive relevance and leveraging existing organizational expertise
Dependency chain between T01 and T02 is logically sound — high-Ni precursor uniformization providing foundational process knowledge for solid-state cathode optimization
weaknesses: All technologies complete after their respective market boom windows, meaning the portfolio fails to achieve the preemptive market positioning that defines 기술선도 strategy
Portfolio is too small (3 technologies) and too concentrated in near-commercialization TRL ranges (4-6) to represent a genuine technology leadership posture — lacks truly exploratory early-stage bets
missing_technologies: Single-crystal cathode morphology engineering (TRL 2-3) for long-term technology leadership positioning
Lithium-sulfur or lithium-air cathode materials for next-generation beyond-lithium-ion leadership
AI-driven cathode composition discovery / high-throughput computational screening (TRL 3-4)
investment_issues: T03 (나트륨 이차전지 음극 소재) is classified as 'High' tier despite being an anode material — in a cathode-materials-domain company, this represents a capability stretch that may not justify Strategic-level resourcing relative to core cathode competencies
Budget is fully exhausted (0% slack) leaving no contingency for acceleration if timing corrections are needed to achieve pre-boom completion for T02 or T03
Executability scores of 2.0-3.0 across the portfolio combined with full budget utilization creates high execution risk with no financial buffer
timing_issues: T02 고체전지 양극 소재 최적화 completes 1.5 years after the 2028-Q3 boom — the most critical miss, as solid-state battery is the highest-value opportunity in the portfolio
T03 나트륨 이차전지 음극 소재 completes exactly 1 year after the 2029-Q1 boom, losing first-mover advantage in the sodium-ion market window
No technology in the portfolio achieves pre-boom completion, which is the defining requirement for 기술선도 timing strategy
